items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: He had a Willie Carnish, a big trombone player then.

ctx.x: Yeah, but Frank, he was the ratty one, you know. Had his parents all on, buttoned in the front. He had suspenders on. His parents would whip him out of his waist. Big silk hanker. Big old studsion hat on his head. Uh-huh. Well, that night, that dance, everybody was saying, who that new clandette player? Yes, there was, go now, see a fella up in there. You know, he's very bright. Big old. He had a lot of hair. He had a big old champagne color, stuffed in a wide hat like a cardboard hat. Blue eyes, you know. Oh,…
Where did you hear them play? Huh? Where did you hear the Bowling Band play?
